notes.title: I can speak Chinese now!
notes.content:
Hi all.

A lot of you guys wanted me to learn how to speak Chinese so I spent a lot of time learning. Hopefully you guys can understand me :D.

notes.title: Thank you all.

If anyone wants to have a talk, join me on [url=https://discord.gg/6CAgmXkDH4]Discord[/url].

Love,
Ruka
